headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.84 (95% CI: 0.68–1.04), indicating no statistically significant association between Vitamin B2 and kidney and renal pelvis cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by low heterogeneity (I² = 0.00%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
